verdict: Smartlead: Choose Smartlead when cold-email infrastructure is the job — treat it as SI landscape coverage, not a ranked contact-database pick. Scores use the sales-intelligence editorial methodology from first-party research — not hands-on product testing.
strengths: Clear cold-email landscape peer to Instantly/lemlist
weaknesses: Not an SI data-core peer — landscape only
Dynamic pricing UI needs live confirmation
CRM sync lighter than enterprise SEP
bestFor: Teams whose primary job is cold-email sending with unlimited mailboxes
Buyers wanting published Base volume bands and a free trial
notIdealFor: Buyers whose primary need is a B2B contact mega-database
tradeoffs: Data depth / intent specialization vs outreach execution built-in
Published price transparency vs enterprise custom quoting
Specialization fit vs all-in-one SMB consolidation
recommendation: Choose Smartlead when cold-email infrastructure is the job — treat it as SI landscape coverage, not a ranked contact-database pick. Compare Instantly/lemlist for cold-email peers; Outreach/Salesloft for enterprise SEP; Apollo/Hunter when data+light outreach is primary.
editorialNotes: SI Priority-4 onboarding 2026-08-17. Approved on sales-intelligence-editorial v1.0.0. handsOnTesting=false. Affiliate economics excluded.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Verified prospect email allowances support sending, but Smartlead is not a primary SI contact database.
List/campaign prospecting for cold email; weaker than dedicated SI search databases.
Limited enrichment relative to SI enrichment platforms; focus is mailbox/warmup/sending.
Unlimited mailboxes, warmups, and high-volume cold email are a category strength.
CRM access/connectors are documented; lighter than Outreach/Salesloft bi-directional SEP depth.
Simple cold-email plan ladder and free trial path suit SMB/agency senders.
Campaign analytics support outbound ops; not enterprise SI analytics.
Base yearly headline from ~$39/mo is accessible; confirm live volume bands before buying.

overallScoreRationale: Equal-weight average of 8 sales-intelligence editorial criteria, rounded to 1 decimal. Not a hands-on lab score.
